title: A1 Grammar Quiz 1 — To Be, Articles, Pronouns

questions.question: I ___ a student.
questions.explanation: 'I' + 'am'. Am is used only with I.

questions.question: She ___ from Spain.
questions.explanation: 'She' is third person singular → 'is'.

questions.question: They ___ my friends.
questions.explanation: 'They' is plural → 'are'.

questions.question: We ___ in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 'We' is plural → 'are'.

questions.question: He ___ a doctor.
questions.explanation: 'He' is third person singular → 'is'.

questions.question: I ___ tired today.
questions.explanation: Negative of 'am' is 'am not'. There is no contraction 'amn't' in standard English.

questions.question: ___ you a teacher?
questions.explanation: Question with 'you' → 'Are you...?'

questions.question: I have ___ cat.
questions.explanation: 'Cat' starts with a consonant sound → use 'a'.

questions.question: She eats ___ apple every day.
questions.explanation: 'Apple' starts with a vowel sound → use 'an'.

questions.question: ___ sun is very hot today.
questions.explanation: There is only one sun — we use 'the' for unique things.

questions.question: He is ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: 'Engineer' starts with a vowel sound /ɛ/ → use 'an'.

questions.question: I live in ___ big house.
questions.explanation: 'Big' starts with a consonant → 'a big house'.

questions.question: That is my bag. Give it to ___.
questions.explanation: After a verb or preposition, use object pronoun 'me', not subject pronoun 'I'.

questions.question: ___ name is Anna.
questions.explanation: 'Her' is a possessive adjective used before a noun: 'Her name'.

questions.question: This is Tom. ___ is my brother.
questions.explanation: Subject pronoun for a male person → 'He'.

questions.question: The book is ___. Don't take it.
questions.explanation: 'Mine' is a possessive pronoun — it replaces 'my + noun'. No noun follows here.

questions.question: Can you help ___? I can't open this door.
questions.explanation: Object pronoun after a verb → 'help me'.

questions.question: ___ are my glasses. (near)
questions.explanation: 'Glasses' is plural and near → 'These'.

questions.question: ___ is my house. (far)
questions.explanation: Singular and far → 'That'.

questions.question: ___ boys over there are my cousins.
questions.explanation: Plural and far → 'Those'.

questions.question: ___ a dog in the garden.
questions.explanation: 'A dog' is singular → 'There is'.

questions.question: ___ three books on the table.
questions.explanation: 'Three books' is plural → 'There are'.

questions.question: ___ any milk in the fridge?
questions.explanation: 'Milk' is uncountable (treated as singular) → 'Is there'.

questions.question: We love ___ school.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjective before a noun → 'our school'.

questions.question: The cat drinks ___ milk.
questions.explanation: 'Its' (no apostrophe) is the possessive adjective for animals/things. 'It's' = 'it is'.

questions.question: She ___ 10 years old.
questions.explanation: In English, age is expressed with 'to be': 'She is 10 years old'.

questions.question: I ___ at home yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past tense of 'am/is' → 'was'. Used with I/he/she/it.

questions.question: They ___ happy at the party.
questions.explanation: Past tense of 'are' → 'were'. Used with you/we/they.

questions.question: I want to be ___ actor when I grow up.
questions.explanation: 'Actor' starts with a vowel sound /æ/ → 'an actor'.

questions.question: ___ she your sister?
questions.explanation: Question with 'she' → 'Is she...?'
